note: frames[res][key] = [sheet index, x, y, w, h, anchorX, anchorY]. Draw so that (x + anchorX, y + anchorY) lands on the sprite position. Sheets with mask: the mask for a frame is at the same x and y + maskOffsetY. Team colour (linear light): out = toSRGB(toLinear(base) + toLinear(mask.r) * toLinear(paint) + toLinear(mask.g) * toLinear(light)). One tank: shadow/hull and shadow/turret (blend the two with max), then hull/<size>/s<state>/d<dd>/f0, then if the track frame f is 1..3 and track.mode is "overlay" draw hull/.../f<f> on top at the same position (with mode "full" draw f<f> instead of f0), then turret/<size>/<weapon>/s<state>/d<dd> at hull position + models[<size>_<weapon>].turretPivot1x[hull dir] * scale. The turret shadow goes at hull position + turretGround1x[hull dir] * scale. muzzles1x[turret dir] are from the turret position, firePoints1x[hull dir] from the hull position. wreck/<size>/<weapon>/d<dd> exists for even directions only and replaces everything.
